lines.zh: 我摇摇晃晃地走，叶子跟着动。
lines.en: I waddle along, my leaves swaying.

lines.zh: 我身上长着叶子，像个小花盆。
lines.en: Leaves grow out of me, like a flowerpot.

lines.zh: 我踩着松土，一步一步挪。
lines.en: I shuffle through the loose soil, step by step.

lines.zh: 我是一片一片挪过去的。
lines.en: I move over patch by patch.
The sprout on my head keeps wobbling.

lines.zh: 我跟在你后面，不敢走远。
lines.en: I follow you. I don't stray far.
I'm looking for shoots in the grass.

lines.zh: 我走起路来，叶子沙沙响。
lines.en: Walking, my leaves rustle.

lines.zh: 我绕开石头，怕碰掉叶子。
lines.en: I go around stones so no leaf falls.
I shift beside you and stop.
In the woods, I walk sure.

lines.zh: 我一边走，一边低头闻土。
lines.en: I walk with my head down, sniffing soil.
I stand and bask slowly.
My leaves open and close.
I'm waiting to be assigned work.

lines.zh: 我喜欢土，喜欢潮湿的地方。
lines.en: I like soil. I like damp places.

lines.zh: 我低头，把根扎进土里一点。
lines.en: I lower myself and settle my roots.
The wind blows and I sway.
I smell of earth.
I yawn slowly.
This wood feels good.
I don't like dry places.
I count my own leaves.
I squat in the soil, waiting for the sun.
I hear water. Over there.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转过来，跟着太阳。
lines.en: I turn slowly to follow the sun.

lines.zh: 你种东西吗？我可以帮忙。
lines.en: Do you plant things? I can help.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，叶子晃了晃。
lines.en: I look up at you. My leaves wobble.

lines.zh: 这土味，是从森林带来的。
lines.en: That soil smell came from the forest.

lines.zh: 我往你旁边挪了一步，叶子晃了晃。
lines.en: I shift beside you and my leaves sway.

lines.zh: 我不怕你，你也不像要吃我。
lines.en: I'm not afraid. You don't look hungry.
Want to touch my leaves?

lines.zh: 我低下头，叶脉都给你看。
lines.en: I bow my head, showing you my leaf veins.
I'm tame. No need to fear.

lines.zh: 我躲在叶子后面，露出半个头。
lines.en: I hide behind a leaf, half a head showing.
Leaving? I'll follow.

lines.zh: 针叶林里，我的根扎得深。
lines.en: In the taiga, my roots go deep.

lines.zh: 你身上的味道，我没闻过。
lines.en: Your scent is new to me.
May I come a little closer?

lines.zh: 我抬起叶尖，等你弯下腰。
lines.en: I lift my leaf tips, waiting for you to bend down.
I've taken my place by your feet.
When you smile, I relax.
One of my leaves fell.
I shrink, leaves pulled in.
My leaves knocked askew, I straighten them.
I steady myself. Still here.

lines.zh: 我不太疼，只是掉了东西。
lines.en: It doesn't hurt much. I just lost something.
Half a step back, behind the tree.
My roots have loosened.
I shake and soil falls.
Don't step on me. I'll break.
I'm still growing. Please don't.
Leaves! Freshly sprouted tender leaves!

lines.zh: 我一点点挪过去，不碰你手。
lines.en: I inch over without touching your hand.
I can eat this. Thank you.
Bite by bite. Slowly.
Shoots are best. Old ones won't chew.
Done. I'd like more.

lines.zh: 你把叶子放低，我就够到了。
lines.en: Lower the leaf and I can reach.
My own leaves are swaying too.

lines.zh: 我种过这个，知道怎么长。
lines.en: I've planted this. I know how it grows.
Done chewing, I lick the corner of my mouth.

lines.zh: 这个味道，我在土里闻过。
lines.en: I've smelled this in the soil.
One sniff and I step back.
I bump and two leaves fall.
The flower I bloom casts petit thunder.
Sorry. I'm slow.

lines.zh: 我很轻，撞一下也没什么。
lines.en: I'm light. A bump is nothing.

lines.zh: 我侧过身，让出一块地方。
lines.en: I angle aside to make room.

lines.zh: 这一下，把我撞得转了个向。
lines.en: That turned me around.
I turn back slowly to get my bearings.
I pat off the dirt. It's real dirt.

lines.zh: 你踩在我叶片上，快挪开。
lines.en: You're on my leaf — move off.
I move aside. Not in the way.
My kind grows rather than hatches.

lines.zh: 我把叶子伸过去，碰了碰。
lines.en: I extend a leaf and touch.
Two little ones standing together.

lines.zh: 我们不说话，只有叶子响。
lines.en: Neither speaks. Only leaves rustle.
Something new will come from the soil.
This part is quiet.

lines.zh: 我们慢慢摇，像是在点头。
lines.en: We sway slowly, as if nodding.

lines.zh: 天黑了，我们就各自扎下根。
lines.en: At dark we each settle our roots.
Enough soil here to grow in.
It shuffles off. I stay.
I curl a leaf around it to hold it.

lines.zh: 这个咬不动，我放回土上。
lines.en: This won't bite; I set it back on the soil.

lines.zh: 我把它按进土里，试试能不能长。
lines.en: I press it into the soil to see if it grows.
I sniff it: a cold stone.
Too small for my vine to curl around.
I'll take it back and plant it.

lines.zh: 你递过来，我就用藤接住。
lines.en: Hand it over and my vine will take it.
I bury it carefully.

lines.zh: 这东西不能吃，还是埋了吧。
lines.en: Not edible. Better buried.
I hold it and stand by the flowers.

lines.zh: 有东西靠近了，我抬起头。
lines.en: Something's near. I raise my head.
I raise my leaves.
I dislike being stepped on.
I back up toward a tree.
I'll protect this garden.

lines.zh: 我的叶子张开，挡住你的路。
lines.en: My leaves spread, blocking your way.

lines.zh: 我细声叫了一下，像风吹叶。
lines.en: I give a thin cry, like wind through leaves.

lines.zh: 我准备好了，虽然我不太会打。
lines.en: I'm ready, though I'm no fighter.
I'm in charge of this soil.

lines.zh: 你退开，我的叶子就舒展。
lines.en: You back off, and my leaves unfurl.
I dig my roots in tight.
I sway slowly, waiting for you.

lines.zh: 我一直朝你，叶子也朝你。
lines.en: I face you. My leaves too.
You move; I sway.
I stand in front of the garden.
I'm not fast, but I won't yield.

lines.zh: 我把身体压低，像一丛草。
lines.en: I flatten out like a clump of grass.

lines.zh: 你进一步，我的叶子就缩一寸。
lines.en: Each step you take, my leaves pull in an inch.
I'm waiting for someone to help.
This patch of pine wood, I know best.
I shift a little further behind the tree.
Don't touch me, and my leaves won't bristle.

lines.zh: 我把叶子张开了，看起来大一些。
lines.en: I spread my leaves to look bigger.

lines.zh: 我叫了，主人应该听见了。
lines.en: I called. My owner should have heard.
I swing my leaves at it.

lines.zh: 一点点电，从我身上冒出来。
lines.en: A little charge sparks off me.
That's barely a push.
I bump into it. Not much force.

lines.zh: 我打中了，自己也很惊讶。
lines.en: I hit it. Even I'm surprised.
Afterward I retreat to the garden's edge.
I'm no fighter. This is all I can do.
Enough to make it step back.
I shake; my leaves rattle.
It shrinks back into the grass and I stop.
I throw my whole body at it.

lines.zh: 这一下，把我自己也撞歪了。
lines.en: That knocked me crooked too.

lines.zh: 我从土里冒出来，叶子还是嫩的。
lines.en: I come up out of the soil, leaves still tender.

lines.zh: 我先伸了伸叶子，试试太阳。
lines.en: I stretch my leaves to test the sun.
Loose soil here. Good.
I straighten slowly and sway twice.
Plenty of trees here. Just right.

lines.zh: 我看了看四周，没有别人。
lines.en: I look around. No one else.
I smell water. Close by.

lines.zh: 针叶林里，我扎根又走路。
lines.en: In the conifers, I root and walk.

lines.zh: 我身上的叶子，一片一片张开。
lines.en: My leaves open one by one.
I'm ready to work.
I stand in the shade. Cool.
I'll grow taller. Slowly.
Fire curls my leaves.
I fall and my roots tear.
Too much water. My roots rot.

lines.zh: 炸响把我的叶子都打散了。
lines.en: The blast scatters my leaves.

lines.zh: 东西穿过叶子，钉在我身上。
lines.en: It pierces a leaf and sticks in me.
Light wraps me and my leaves close.

lines.zh: 很久没吃到叶子，我干了。
lines.en: No leaves for too long. I'm drying.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我身上的电全乱了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and my charge scatters.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有土，我的根抓空。
lines.en: No soil in the void; my roots grasp nothing.
